title: Amazing way to see Barcelona!
text: Bosco was absolutely amazing! We had such an amazing time and it was honestly the best way to see a large part of the city in such a relatively short amount of time and for the price. Would highly recommend!
author: 981brennar

title: Must do in Barcelona
text: What a great way to see Barcelona.  My friend and I had been to Barcelona multiple times and seen all the highlights.  We picked this tour because it looked like a different experience.  We almost canceled because the weather was so bad in the morning….so glad we did not.  Our guide, Bosco, first of all was extremely patient and accommodating to our late arrival due to the weather.  He spoke perfect English and was full of facts about the history and architecture of Barcelona.  I always felt safe in regards to the traffic.  Barcelona has a wonderful network of bike lanes. author: 684jang

title: Bosco knows Barcelona
text: Our guide Bosco was excellent, very knowledgeable and also stresses safety for our first time ebikers.
author: JeremyL123

title: E-bike tour with Jordi highly recommended
text: Jordi was an awesome guide.  He knows the history of this city.  The e-bike tour was amazing to do.  He was also patient because we were over an hour late because of the ship disembarking and lack of taxis.  He waited for us and we still got the full experience.  I would highly recommend taking a tour with him.  He is also accommodating to us because if we wanted to stop for pictures, to get a drink, or use a bathroom.  There was no pressure to keep going, he was just going which made the experience even more enjoyable
author: J2065ZJpatrickj

title: Great tour
text: We had an amazing e-bike tour with Jordi! He is very knowledgeable about the city and has a great personality. We saw the entire city and biking was a great way to do it.
author: GrumpyChiefsfan

title: Ebike Tour
text: This was, hands down, the best activity we did while in Barcelona. Jordi was an excellent guide, shared a ton of history with us, and made our tour so much fun! This was a great way to see a lot of the city.
author: L6524AImorganj

title: Jordi is a 5-Star Tour Guide!
text: Jordi was nothing short of amazing today! He gave us a thorough tour of the key parts of Barcelona and shared valuable history along the way. His English was perfect and he made the entire tour fun and engaging throughout. I would definitely recommend him to anyone looking to better understand the history and sections of Barcelona!
author: 875travisj

title: A Unique and Memorable Experience
text: We had a fantastic tour with Carlos! Exploring the city by e-bike, cable car, and boat was such a unique and enjoyable way to experience the sights. Carlos was an excellent guide—friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive. He made sure we were comfortable, went at our pace, and ensured we had a great day. Highly recommend this tour with Carlos!
author: Tania_M

title: Great way to the city
text: Great way to see overview of city including history. E bikes are great way to get around and easy to use. Carlos was amazing - informative, pleasant with a sense of humor. Highly recommended if you like bike riding.
author: Robert R

title: Cycling Fun with Jordi
text:
Jordi did an excellent job with our tour. He was fun, enthusiastic and shared many details of Barcelona.  He had an excellent sense of humor and it was obvious that he loved his job. We loved all the places Jordi showed us and totally enjoyed the excursion. 
Carolyn and Paul - Winnipeg
